answer.rationale: Do not respond to the competitor with broad promotional pricing: the recovered price-sensitive SMB experiment raised signup and qualified revenue but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, directly conflicting with sustainable long-term qualified revenue. Roll out the already confirmed simplified onboarding, which improved completion, reduced time-to-value, and increased 30-day retention; prior SMB evidence also showed a durable first-week activation lift. This is not a complete answer to price-driven churn, but it is the strongest validated sustainable lever available without further verification.
